theme_strategy.rationale: Organic, ecological, and civil-tech dashboard theme anchored in Sahyadri Konkan environmental aesthetics. Earthy emeralds, warm stone, and crisp tactile panels with high contrast for mobile inspection and daylight demo presentation.

entry_surfaces./: split hero & pin-lock entry — brand identity with Chiplun Sahyadri credentials on left/top, 4-digit demo PIN keypad & project overview on right/bottom
entry_surfaces./scan: interactive camera viewfinder & file dropzone with real-time classification preview and barcode/hint inputs
entry_surfaces./assistant: multilingual AI waste assistant split interface with quick prompts, classifier context injection, and voice/audio toggles
entry_surfaces./facilities: interactive Leaflet Chiplun map container with waste category filters, distance cards, and route guidance
entry_surfaces./dashboard: gamified scan analytics grid with waste composition charts, eco-points tracker, and Sahyadri Nisarg Mitra impact stats

rules.overlines: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-300
rules.marathi_hindi_support: Clean unicode fallback rendering with explicit lang attributes for EN/MR/HI text switches

layouts.navigation: Sticky glass header with Sahyadri NGO badge, language toggle (EN/HI/MR), Demo Status indicator, and bottom mobile navigation bar on handheld screens (Scan, AI Chat, Facilities Map, Analytics Dashboard)
layouts.grid_structure: Responsive bento grid with `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12` and generous `gap-4 md:gap-6` spacing
layouts.containers: Solid tactile panels with `p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8`, `rounded-2xl`, subtle border `border-emerald-950/8` and warm ambient shadow `shadow-sm`

motion.transitions: transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0.2s ease, border-color 0.15s ease
motion.camera_pulse: animate-pulse for live camera scanner targeting reticle

accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case functional IDs on all buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, map pins, and chat controls
accessibility.aria_labels: Explicit aria-label attributes on icon-only buttons, camera toggles, language switchers, and audio controls
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab ordering, enter/space trigger on custom category chips and map selector lists

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `leaflet` and `@types/leaflet` via yarn before building map components (`yarn add leaflet @types/leaflet`).
Use pre-bundled `recharts` for category breakdown and scan history chart visualization.
Implement the PIN Gate screen (default student demo PIN `2026` with visual keypad, quick demo bypass button, and student project banner).

Ensure multilingual support in AI Assistant with seamless language tabs: English, Hindi (हिंदी), and Marathi (मराठी) with local context on Chiplun, Ratnagiri, and E-Waste Management Rules 2022 (CPCB).
Provide sample waste photo presets (E-waste motherboard, PET bottle, Coconut shell/organic, Li-ion battery, Cardboard) so evaluator can test classification instantly even without live camera feed.
Include high-contrast badges for categories: E-Waste (Amber), Recyclable (Blue), Organic (Green), Hazardous (Red), General (Slate).
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements, camera trigger, file input, language buttons, PIN buttons, filter chips, and map action cards.
Ensure mobile-responsive ergonomics with sticky bottom navigation tabs on small screens and intuitive touch targets.
